name: Mount Miwa
text: Mount Miwa (三輪山, Miwa-yama) or Mount Mimoro (三諸山, Mimoro-yama) is a mountain located in the city of Sakurai, Nara Prefecture, Japan. It has been an important religious and historical mountain in Japan, especially during its early history, and serves as a holy site in Shinto. The entire mountain is considered sacred, and is home to one of the earliest Shinto shrines, Ōmiwa Shrine.

depictions.name: Mount Miwa
depictions.text: Mount Miwa is a mountain located west of Uda Matsuyama Castle in Yamato, Japan.
